title: Mexican Debris
description: A mod based on a mishearing I had in 5th grade. What could possibly go wrong?
body:
This mod is an idea that my friend and I have had for a long time. It all started when my friend said something (i dont remember what it actually was) and I misheard him as saying "Mexican Debris". I thought to myself huh that sounds like ancient debris (1.16 had recently released). I mentioned it to him and he said I should make a mod. And so many years later here it is. It has a lot more than originaly thought of and with more to come in versions in the future. It contains the following (v 1.0.0; for future version features, check the changelog):

- Mexican Debris (spawns in desert biomes)
- Mexican Ingots, Scraps, and Shards
- Full Mexican Tool and Armor Set
- Block of Mexico
- Mexican Upgrade Template
- Mexican Arrow
- New Weapon - Mexican Scythe
- Cheese (Block and Item)
- Pizza and Mexican Pizza Blocks (cake functionality)
- Tomato Plant
- Tomato Item
- Taco Item
- Strike Enchantment
- Peppermint Forest Biome
- Full Peppermint Wood set
- Peppermint Effect
- Peppermint Bark
- Peppermint Apple
- Pangolin Scale
- Pangolin Cap
- Hunter Mob
- Hunter's Wagon and Hunter's camp Structures
- 9 New Advancements
